description: Figure 3(a) illustrates the relationship between training steps and bit-per-character (BPC) loss for the SMoE routing policy. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60,000, with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.4 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Two lines are displayed: a purple line with circle markers representing “SMoE Validating”, and a light purple line with plus markers representing “SMoE Training”. The “SMoE Validating” line begins at approximately 2.18 at a training step of 0, decreases to approximately 1.72 at a training step of 20,000, and then remains relatively steady at approximately 1.70 until a training step of 60,000. The “SMoE Training” line begins at approximately 2.18 at a training step of 0, decreases to approximately 1.68 at a training step of 20,000, and then remains relatively steady at approximately 1.66 until a training step of 60,000.
